params.message:
Werf fiche: more than one site in a day, and a site he types himself

The start screen offered one site: once a site was on the fiche the choice
was gone, and a site in no list could only be said, not typed.

- "Werf toevoegen" on the board, next to machine and material: his other
  recent sites, the search, and a field for a name.
- "Staat je werf er niet bij? Typ de naam." wherever sites are offered (start
  screen, the site question, the board). The line goes on the fiche under
  his words, without a project, for the office to link; the conversation is
  told to take it over by exactly that name. The same name twice is one line.
- Tapping a site no longer fills a line that has a typed name: that line is
  his site too, and the tap used to overwrite it.
